description: One published comparison: the exact product, every approved offer with its seller, price, stated shipping, known total, evidence status and last automated check, whether the price changed since the editors' review, sourced end dates, and the editorial verdict. last_human_review and last_price_check are separate facts. The lowest known total is named only among the offers PostThisDeal checked; commission is never a ranking input.
name: get_comparison
title: Get an editor-reviewed price comparison
